---
description: 'Pick up a ready Beads issue and deliver it, stopping for review at each commit.'
---

Follow the instructions in `.github/skills/beads-implement/SKILL.md` exactly, and do
not begin until you have read that file.

The workflow lives in the skill rather than here because Copilot CLI discovers
`.github/skills/` but not `.github/prompts/`. This file exists so the same workflow is
available as `/beads-implement` in VS Code. The skill is the single source of truth;
this pointer must never grow into a second copy of it.
